events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 keep up their winning ways a 3–0 home win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 셰필드 웬즈데이 are still looking for their first Premier League win six games into the season when they are held to a 3–3 draw at home to 노리치 시티. Coventry hold on to fourth place with a 1–0 home win over 리버풀, who drop one place into third. 맨체스터 시티 achieve their first win of the season with a 3–1 away win over Swindon, who have picked up one point from their opening six games.
Paul Warhurst moves from 셰필드 웬즈데이 to 블랙번 로버스 in a £2.75million deal – the fifth highest fee between English clubs.
The Black Country derby is contested for the first time in three seasons, with 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 beating 울버햄프턴 원더러스 3–2 at The Hawthorns .
Colombia national football team pull one of the largest upsets in football by defeating Argentina national football team 5–0 in Buenos Aires , Argentina.
England put their World Cup qualification hopes back on track with a 3–0 win over Poland at Wembley .

Kevin Campbell scores a hat-trick in 아스널's 4–0 home league win over 입스위치 타운. 에리크 캉토나 's shot from the halfway line at Stamford Bridge hits the crossbar, and a Gavin Peacock goal gives 첼시 a 1–0 win over 맨체스터 유나이티드. Down in Division One, 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 climb six places from the foot of the table with a spectacular 4–2 home win over 브리스틀 시티 .
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 셰필드 웬즈데이 4–2 in the only league action of the day.
트랜미어 로버스 go top of Division One with a 4–1 home win over bottom club 루턴 타운 .
맨체스터 유나이티드 beat Honved of Hungary 3–2 away in their first European Cup fixture since 1969.
After two months at 포츠머스, Lee Chapman returns to the Premier League with newly promoted 웨스트햄 유나이티드 for £250,000.
리버풀 sign 웨스트햄 유나이티드 defender Julian Dicks for £1.5million, with Mike Marsh and David Burrows going to Upton Park in exchange.

맨체스터 유나이티드 go into their fixture with second placed 아스널 as Premier League leaders on goal difference, but then go ahead by three points with a 1–0 victory at Old Trafford . 노팅엄 포리스트's erratic start to their Division One season continues with a 3–2 home defeat to 스토크 시티 .

The first leg of round two in the Football League Cup sees top-flight clubs 올덤 애슬레틱 and 셰필드 유나이티드 beaten by Division Two opposition, while Premier League outfit 리즈 유나이티드 lose away at 선덜랜드 from Division One. Elsewhere, Paul Rideout 's hat-trick-completing late winner against basement tier club 링컨 시티 avoids another upset, Division Two side 렉섬 draw 3–3 with First Division 노팅엄 포리스트 and 이언 라이트 scores a hat-trick as 아스널 put five past 허더즈필드 타운 without reply.

Mark Stein scores twice for 스토크 시티 in their surprise 2–1 over 맨체스터 유나이티드 in the first leg of the League Cup second round at the Victoria Ground . South African born Stein, 27, is a target for several Premier League clubs.

에버턴, fourth in the Premier League, suffer a 5–1 defeat at home to 노리치 시티 in one of the most thrilling league games so far this season. 노리치 시티 striker Efan Ekoku scores four goals in the game – the first player to score four goals in a Premier League game. 맨체스터 유나이티드 maintain their lead at the top of the table with a 4–2 home win over Swindon, who are still bottom with no wins and a mere three points from their first nine games. 사우샘프턴 remain level with Swindon at the bottom of the table with a 1–0 defeat at 아스널. An East Midlands derby at Meadow Lane sees 노츠 카운티 beat 더비 카운티 4–1 in Division One.

September draws to a close with 맨체스터 유나이티드 still top of the table, leading by three points over 아스널. 애스턴 빌라, 리즈 유나이티드, 노리치 시티 and 윔블던 are just some of the many other clubs currently in strong contention. 리버풀, meanwhile, have slumped to 13th place after a disappointing month, mounting the pressure upon 그레임 수네스 . Swindon are still bottom of the table and looking for their first-ever top division win after nine games, being level on points with a 사우샘프턴 side who have lost eight of their first nine games, while 올덤 애슬레틱 have fallen into the relegation zone as well. In the race to win promotion to the Premier League, 크리스털 팰리스 top Division One on goal difference ahead of 트랜미어 로버스 . The playoff zone is occupied by 레스터 시티 , 찰턴 애슬레틱, 미들즈브러 and 사우스엔드 유나이티드.
